prompt: RimWorld creature sprite, side view, flat cel-shaded vanilla-RimWorld toy-figurine art style: the Star Wars canon Nuna, matching the owner-ruled reference design/RimStarWars/canon_references/nuna/wookieepedia_infobox.jpg (owner ruling, 2026-09-14: "E3 is canon. May need suggestion of thick bird-like legs to avoid making it look like a frog.") -- a squat, hunched, toad-or-turtle-shaped biped with a heavy domed/ridged shell-like back, a wide froglike head with a broad flat mouth, bulging pink-amber eyes, and floppy skin flaps at the sides of the head. Skin is vivid green. Per the owner's ruling, give it clearly bird-like legs. Single creature, centered, calm standing pose, no ground shadow, no background scenery. Heavy, clean black outline around the whole silhouette and all major internal linework, thick enough to read clearly at standard RimWorld zoom and below. Toy-figurine convention, strict: calm neutral standing pose -- never mid-stride, stalking, leaping or rearing; pure flat side profile with no three-quarter perspective; no visible musculature, tendon or anatomy detail; flat cel shading with large simple color areas and minimal surface texture, clean vanilla-RimWorld style. Leg policy, identity-limb exception (owner ruling): unlike the default stub-leg budget, Nuna's legs ARE an identity feature and must stay prominent-simple -- two thick, sturdy, upright bird-like legs (not hidden stub nubs), simplified with no individual toes beyond a single rounded clawed foot, so the silhouette reads as a stout ground bird rather than a sitting frog. Leave roughly a 3% transparent margin on all sides of the canvas; do not bleed the silhouette to the canvas edge.
